scope: Shared persistent combat-element preference integrated into existing clearance casualty promotion
finding: Clearance casualty replacement sorted its rotating candidate window by distance only. Assault/advance/refill already use CombatElementSelect to prefer receiving-team buddies and intact registered pairs. New clearance recruits could therefore separate an eligible registered buddy pair despite existing identity metadata.
implementation: Filter the at-most16 promotion candidates to those still in the reserve roster, preserving distance/identity sorting. Apply the existing read-only CombatElementSelect with maximum2/minimum1 and the healthy receiving buddy, if present. Reorder the same candidate rows to put the preference first, then retain all remaining candidates. Existing failed actual-VIEW-probe rotation occurs afterward, before the unchanged promotion coverage gate. Actual promotion keeps exact native-task/pose/watch/observer/generation proof and updates common participants through existing atomic code.
authority: Preference grants no movement, exit-cover, settings or admission rights. No pair registry is rewritten. A previously promoted first-slot actor cannot remain among candidates when supplied as second-slot incumbent. An unavailable/sole-exit-security buddy may refuse; other reserves remain eligible under existing fairness.
cost: No additional world query, geometry, handler or worker. Bounded candidate membership checks against existing reserve list, at most16candidate/16registry selection rows and at most2 preferred-row lookups per vacant slot. Original one-VIEW promotion budget and clearance deadline unchanged; runtime cost unmeasured.
remaining: Physical buddy reunion, concurrent entry, whole-pair replacement continuity, casualty relief, repeated normal/HC episodes and runtime performance remain unverified or incomplete. This does not complete the CLEAR family or renew stale master percentages.
provenance: Unsigned dirty development snapshot based on940c49d4 plus implementation and unrelated pre-existing dirt. Private review/handover postdate package.
